statement: Anthropic's confidential IPO prospectus, as reported by Reuters, sets out at least $518 billion of AI infrastructure spending over a decade across six partners, with about 80% non-cancelable or payable regardless of usage.
why: Non-cancelable commitments of this size are the firmest kind of forward compute demand: they are paid whether or not the capacity is used, so they hold up orders even if usage disappoints.

impact.mechanism: Take-or-pay infrastructure obligations to cloud and equipment partners fund accelerator, memory and data-center procurement on a fixed schedule.

evidence.excerpt: Anthropic said it expects to spend at least $518 billion over a decade building AI infrastructure with six partners, according to a confidential IPO prospectus seen by Reuters
About 80% of that sum is non-cancelable or requires payment regardless of usage.

confidence.basis: Wire report on a confidential prospectus that the document says has not been publicly disclosed, so the filing itself cannot be checked.
